## Checklist

- [ ] Questions are **real** (asked in interviews), not invented trivia
- [ ] Answers are **original** — no text pasted from another site
- [ ] Answer is **staff-level**: core idea → why → trade-offs → the gotcha
- [ ] Each entry has a **Difficulty** and **Tags** line (see [TEMPLATE.md](../TEMPLATE.md))
- [ ] Placed in the correct `questions/` topic file
- [ ] `bash scripts/validate.sh` passes locally
